messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — prepping QBR for Solace Health next week. Their onboarding is ~65% done but token spend spiked last week. Need: 30/90d forecast, guardrails, and a short enablement plan.
Liam (AE): Got it. Can we pull 30d usage + simple run-rate forecast? renewal looks riskier if spend keeps trending up.
Arjun (Solutions): I have a per-route notebook. Will pull 30/90d trends. Quick q: did they enable streaming on any routes or flip to larger max_tokens?
Maya (CS): They turned on streaming for the transcript route and increased max_tokens for summaries. Customer mentioned more hallucination when they upped max_tokens.
Elena (Finance): FYI their committed monthly is $8k. Current run-rate projection (naive linear) hits ~$12k/month if last 30d persists. We should present options: throttles + commit bump + quantization tradeoffs.
billing-bot: Alert created: "budget-alert-solace" threshold set to 80% of committed monthly USD -> notify CS + AE.
Arjun (Solutions): Recommend immediate config changes: lower default max_tokens, enable prefix/KV caching for repeat contexts, and short batching window. Draft snippet to propose: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: transcript
    max_tokens: 1024
    cache: prefix
    batching_ms: 50
  - name: summarize
    max_tokens: 512
    cache: none
    batching_ms: 25
```
Maya (CS): Nice. That snippet + expected cost delta will be useful. Also capture customer feedback: they want guidance that keeps latency under 300ms for interactive flows.
Liam (AE): I'll book a 30-min enablement with their eng leads Tue 10am PT and surface the config + expected savings in plain english.
Elena (Finance): I'll run a cost sim comparing current model (float16) vs quantized 8-bit variant and compute token-unit delta. Preliminary expectation: ~-25% to -30% token cost for generation-heavy routes.
Arjun (Solutions): I'll include those sim numbers in the deck. Also need the raw 90d token CSV from analytics. Command I’ll run if eng-ops grants export: `analytics export --customer solace --range 90d --format csv`
eng-ops: Can do export. Will share blob link once done. ETA 2 hours.
Liam (AE): thumbs up. Also can we set billing alert recipients to maya@redwood.com and liam@redwood.com so we see anomalies early?
billing-bot: Updated alert recipients: maya@redwood.com, liam@redwood.com.
Maya (CS): For the QBR deck, we need 3 slides: 1) current usage + 30/90d forecast, 2) recommended guardrails (alerts + config snippet + expected savings), 3) renewal ask + options (commit tiers or throttles) + risk assessment. Who owns the deck?
Arjun (Solutions): I’ll own the deck and draft by EOD tomorrow. Will tag screenshots and cost sims.
Elena (Finance): I’ll provide the commitment tier table and expected monthly savings numbers.
Maya (CS): Action items recap: 1) Arjun: usage pulls + deck draft + include config snippet. 2) Elena: cost sims + commit tier proposals. 3) Liam: enablement session + customer communications. 4) eng-ops: export token CSV. 5) billing-bot: keep alerts active. Ping if any blockers. :raised_hands:
Liam (AE): On it. I'll prep a 1-page customer note summarizing tradeoffs for them to share internally.
Arjun (Solutions): Will post the draft deck link here when ready.
eng-ops: Export done — uploaded to internal GCS: gs://redwood-exports/solace/solace_90d_tokens_1765439876.csv
Maya (CS): Perfect. Thanks everyone. We'll iterate on the deck and finalize before the QBR.
Elena (Finance): One more ask — include a short slide with "what to expect if we do nothing" (projected overspend + renewal impact). I'll send numbers.
Maya (CS): Good call. Closing thread for now, will reopen if more details needed.
